description:
Track and evaluate the performance of your investment portfolio across stocks, cryptocurrencies, and other assets.


* New: Sifting is now available as an online provider for historical prices.
* New: PDF importers for Alpian, Chase, Fondsdepot Bank, Morgan Stanley, Relai and Swisscard AECS.
* New: The lists of deposit accounts, securities accounts and savings plans can be exported to CSV.
* Improvement: Enhanced PDF importers for 1822direkt, 3 Banken, Advanzia Bank, Baader Bank, Bison, Consorsbank, DEGIRO, DZ Bank, Hello Bank, HypoVereinsbank, Hypothekarbank Lenzburg, ING-DiBa, LGT Bank, Liberty Vorsorge, Merkur Privatbank, MLP Banking, N26, Norddeutsche Landesbank, Oldenburgische Landesbank, Pictet, Postbank, Questrade, Quirin Privatbank, Schelhammer Capital Bank, Sutor Bank, Swissquote, Tradegate, UBS, Union Investment, V-Bank, Vanguard, VDK Bank, Volksbank, VZ VermögensZentrum, Weberbank and Zürcher Kantonalbank.
* Improvement: The Yahoo Finance exchange picker now shows a label for FTSE Global Index quotes (.FGI).
* Improvement: Converting a transaction now keeps the source it was imported from (for example, a buy into a delivery).
* Fix: Historical prices from AMFI India load again after the provider changed its data format.
* Fix: Yahoo Finance now uses the correct exchange code for the Saudi Stock Exchange (.SR).
* Fix: The price preview for the MFAPI quote feed now updates when the scheme code changes.
* Fix: The main tab area can no longer be detached by accident.
